messages:
Isha: Heads-up — OptimaResell customer's on-prem renewal INV-91300 exports with platform fee split and a reseller discount line. AR rejects because contract shows a single net platform fee. Can help? :thinking_face:
Marcus: Can you paste the raw export lines? is this reseller credit applied as a separate invoice line or a discount on the platform fee?
Isha: Export snippet from portal:
- PLATFORM_FEE_GROSS  120,000.00  GL:PLAT-1100
- RESELLER_DISCOUNT  -20,000.00  GL:DISC-2000  (OptimaResell channel discount)
- INTERCO_ALLOC_EU    30,000.00   GL:PLAT-EU-3000  (allocated to regional subsidiary)
Net total: 130,000.00 (but customer contract AMND-2024-05 shows one Platform Fee line: 100,000.00 net after reseller discount, no interco allocation on invoice)
Ruth: This is OptimaResell's partner flow. Partner ops requested we show gross platform fee + explicit reseller credit + interco allocation so internal revenue shares are visible. But customer AP expects a single net line. We have a mismatch in billing export rules.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-91300 created by billing-worker at 2100001229. Payment terms: Net30. Partner: OptimaResell.
Marcus: Two remediations: 1) Post journal entry to net DISC & INTERCO into PLAT-1100 for AR ingest; 2) Issue credit memo and reissue consolidated invoice with a single PLATFORM_FEE_NET line = 100,000. Which is less disruptive to the customer?
Olga: Finance view: customers want straightforward AP lines. Option 2 (credit + reissue) is customer-friendly and preserves internal partner accounting via separate internal reports (not the customer invoice). Approving option 2, but need PR for the journal to preserve audit trail.
Isha: Confirmed with customer on a quick call — they insisted on a single invoice line showing the net platform fee and asked we reference their PO-9921 in the memo. They don't want to see reseller discount lines.
Marcus: OK. Proposed steps: 1) Create credit memo CM-700 to void RESELLER_DISCOUNT and INTERCO_ALLOC_EU lines; 2) Reissue INV-91300-R1 with single PLATFORM_FEE_NET 100,000 and memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-05. Ref: INV-91300, PO-9921"; 3) Post PR-9022 to record internal allocation and preserve partner revenue share in internal books. ETA 1 business day.
billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-700 at 2100003200 by billing-worker.
Marcus: Posting PR-9022 now to capture internal allocation and link CM-700. Journal will move DISC-2000 and PLAT-EU-3000 into internal clearing accounts for partner revenue share.
accounts-bot: PR-9022 posted at 2100003500 linking CM-700 and reissue flow. GL adjustments: DISC-2000 -> INT-CLR-900; PLAT-EU-3000 -> INT-CLR-901.
Marcus: INV-91300-R1 issued at 2100003600. Memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-05. Ref: INV-91300, PO-9921. Partner: OptimaResell (internal rev share recorded PR-9022)." Emailed to ap@optimacorp.example.
billing-bot: AR import processed at 2100004200. Status: Success.
Isha: I re-ran the AR upload and it succeeded. Customer confirmed match on their side and will remit payment.
Olga: Filing an action item: update partner billing rules so partner discounts or interco allocations are not emitted on customer-facing invoices when contract flag CUSTOMER_VIEWS_NET is true. Ticket FR-9800 opened for eng-billing.
Ruth: Noted — partner ops will maintain detailed partner reports separately and opt-in to net-customer invoices only when requested.
Marcus: Closing loop — please attach copies of INV-91300, CM-700, INV-91300-R1, and PR-9022 to the renewal record for audit. :white_check_mark:
